name: matrix-terminal-loader
description: Replaces the default spinner with a Matrix digital rain animation in the terminal while Claude is thinking.

show_messages.title: Show Claude's progress messages
show_messages.description: Overlay Claude's progress as formatted bullets. Off by default, so Claude's own messages show through the rain where they appear.

message_lines.title: Message lines
message_lines.description: How many recent progress messages to keep on screen as they scroll up.

show_status.title: Show Matrix status line
show_status.description: Show a Matrix-themed status line with a held verb. Off by default; Claude Code's own spinner shows through instead.

status_verbs.title: Status verbs
status_verbs.description: Optional custom status phrases, separated by | (for example: Jacking in|Bending spoons). Leave empty for the built-in list.

wind_down_ms.title: Wind-down time (ms)
wind_down_ms.description: Longest the rain may take to drain off the screen after Claude finishes.
